traditional: the Sun square Jupiter: a hard contact. Vitality, authority, and recognition works against growth, fortune, and patronage - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas.
modern: Identity meets optimism, expansion, and luck. Confidence to venture and a sense that the odds will cooperate. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: The same confidence overreaches. Sooner or later the luck gets pushed too far. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for selfhood against growth, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the selfhood/growth form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Confidence and opportunity, with overextension as the standing risk.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center collides with excess and overreach; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: The launch keeps adding features while the budget and sign-off stay put. Sun square Jupiter can make every new promise sound exciting in public while the staff, time, and legal authority needed to deliver it remain exactly the same. Scope grows because optimism keeps winning the meeting. The team inherits every expectation anyway. Freeze the additions long enough to compare the public promise with the resources underneath it. If the numbers did not grow, the scope cannot keep growing for free.
